A '''gray-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception" />

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], specifically [[near-Human]] features, with [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin.<ref name="Deception" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Numerous members of this species could be found incarcerated within the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Deception" /> by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|415}}</ref> with at least some of those inmates taking part in the [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|riot]] that ensued that year, though none that we're aware of successfully managed to escape.<ref name="Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species could first be seen in the background of "[[Deception]]," the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]],<ref name="Deception" /> which aired on [[January 20]], [[2012]]<ref name="CW Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
